Popcorn Rocket now has another 10 languages besides English! The new languages are:

Spanish (Latin American)
French 
Italian 
Portuguese (Brazilian) 
German
Polish
Japanese 
Chinese (Simplified) 
Korean 
Russian

This update was a long time in the making and can now be enjoyed by more people across the world! This update will roll to the demo, Epic, and the Consoles shortly.

notes.title: Patch 1.20 Fix!
notes.notes:
This update fixes the following:

- Level 6 Boss Tractor Beam Fix upon Boss being defeated and carries onto Level 7 with the Popcorn Rocket still being dragged towards the enemy.

- Level 8 Boss Fix for Normal Game and Boss Rush where the game crashes if you collide with one of the roses while it's still on the boss.

- Music fix for Level 10 Boss Rush where the music won't play if the Boss Rush is restarted.

- Various Audio Fixes to balance audio and sound effects better.

notes.title: Popcorn Rocket Demo Update 4/24/23!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/Kll9sHp.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/BGwoCVz.jpg

Based on recent feedback I've gotten, I've added text indicators above the power ups to indicate the type of weapon each of the popcorn power ups will give you. No more guessing and getting a weapon you don't want!

I have also added an indicator for kernels and nova bombs showing how much you've collected and added to your total amount.

Also, I have done more optimization to reduce lag in certain parts along with fixing the bugs I've seen in recent let's plays of the game on YouTube. Watching these videos has been incredibly helpful since people can catch all the stuff that I've been unable to catch.

I'm still working hard on the achievements for the full game which have been incredibly difficult to work with, but every day I'm getting closer to making them work properly. We're getting very close to the finish line, but we're still a ways off.

The demo should automatically update and enjoy!

If you have any additional feedback on the demo, or want to report more bugs and glitches, let me know!

- Ryan

notes.title: Popcorn Rocket Demo Update 4/5/2013!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, based on the demo feedback, I have made a ton of new updates to make things a far better experience for players. Here are the updates for 4/5/2023!

https://i.imgur.com/j0mJq8m.png
New Control Reference Sheet
Players who need to know the exact controller and keyboard controls can now access a nifty sheet in the options and pause menu!

https://i.imgur.com/Thq1vQI.png
Rapid Fire Option
Tired of mashing your thumb to fire? Now you can turn on rapid fire to just hold down the fire button to blast away at enemies! No more carpal tunnel syndrome!

Boss Warning Skip
You can now press select/back/shift to skip the "WARNING" alert at bosses so you can get right into the action when you continue!

2nd Form Boss Continue Spot
If you lose to the 2nd form of a boss and continue, you can start over at the 2nd form without having to beat the first form again!

Huge thanks to everyone who's given constructive feedback over the week! It's really helped me make the game better and more accessible to more players!

If you have more feedback or if there's bugs, let me know!

- Ryan
